verdict.rationale: Cline supports scheduling agents via cron through its hub (cline-docs-13/23) and can run headlessly in CI/CD pipelines and chat platforms (cline-docs-17), which enables some event/time-triggered automation. However, there's no evidence of a general-purpose rules engine for arbitrary event-based triggers (e.g., on file save, on webhook, on git push) beyond cron scheduling and CI/CD invocation. missing for 10: user-defined conditional rules tied to arbitrary events (not just cron/CI triggers), a rules/trigger configuration UI or DSL, and independent verification of the scheduling feature working in practice.
